title: bluestep-one project config
description: The project's .claude/bluestep-one.json. The build skill, the tools and the hooks of bluestep-one read it; a folder without it is not a BlueStep One project, and the hooks do nothing there. uxCheck may be left out: config/defaults.json holds the defaults.

one.description: The BlueStep One host the components are served from, and the host whose git serves the component repos.

components.description: The BlueStep One components this folder builds. A build or publish runs only on these ids, and the tab guard lets a lone build or publish of one of them on to the normal permission prompt.

repo.description: Path to the component's checkout, relative to this folder.

testPrefix.description: Name prefix for test data, written out in full (no placeholders). The live check runs on test records whose names start with it.

uxCheck.description: Thresholds of the build skill's UX check (tools/ux-check.mjs), judged on the served screen. A key left out takes the tool's default, the same as config/defaults.json.

firstContentMs.description: ms from a step's start to the first text drawn inside main that is not a skeleton.

lastSkeletonMs.description: ms from a step's start to the last skeleton gone; one still showing at idle stops.

gqlPosts.description: /gql POSTs from a step's start until idle.

layoutShift.description: Cumulative layout shift of a step, the browser's metric (0.1 is its 'good' bound).

consoleErrors.description: console.error calls, uncaught errors and rejections during a step.

failedRequests.description: Requests answered 400 or over, or not answered, during a step.

duplicateNames.description: Pairs of focusable controls with one accessible name inside one card or form section.

idleMs.description: Quiet (no DOM change in main, no /gql call) that ends a step.

maxMs.description: A step not idle by then stops the gate.

skeleton.description: CSS selector of what counts as a skeleton.
